title: Shasha on your phone
display: Shasha is on your Android phone too: a calm YouTube, with no ads and no sign-in.
tts: Shasha is on your Android phone too: a calm YouTube, with no ads and no sign-in.

title: Downloading the app
display: Start by downloading the app file from the Shasha page on GitHub, and open it on your phone.
tts: Start by downloading the app file from the Shasha page on GitHub, and open it on your phone.

title: Allowing the install
display: Your phone will ask: allow installing from this source? Allow it, then tap "Install". It will not ask again.
tts: Your phone will ask: allow installing from this source? Allow it, then tap Install. It will not ask again.

title: Search
display: Open Search, and type what you want. Videos, channels and playlists appear, with no ads between them.
tts: Open Search, and type what you want. Videos, channels and playlists appear, with no ads between them.

title: Channel page
display: On a channel page, you move between the sections: videos, Shorts, and playlists.
tts: On a channel page, you move between the sections: videos, Shorts, and playlists.

title: Background play
display: The player works in the background: the sound carries on while the screen is off, and you do whatever you like.
tts: The player works in the background: the sound carries on while the screen is off, and you do whatever you like.

title: Picture in picture
display: And with one tap, the video becomes a small floating window, called "picture in picture", so you keep watching while you do something else.
tts: And with one tap, the video becomes a small floating window, called picture in picture, so you keep watching while you do something else.

title: Speed
display: You choose the playback speed that suits you: slower to understand, or faster to save time.
tts: You choose the playback speed that suits you: slower to understand, or faster to save time.

title: Skipping sponsor segments
display: And Shasha skips sponsor segments by itself: the ads the video's owner puts inside the video.
tts: And Shasha skips sponsor segments by itself: the ads the video's owner puts inside the video.

title: Downloads
display: For downloads you have two choices: the whole video, or the audio only. So you can watch it with no internet, anywhere.
tts: For downloads you have two choices: the whole video, or the audio only. So you can watch it with no internet, anywhere.

title: Subscriptions
display: You subscribe to the channels you love with one tap, and find all their new videos in one place.
tts: You subscribe to the channels you love with one tap, and find all their new videos in one place.

title: Watch history
display: In your watch history you find everything you watched, so you can continue any video from where you stopped.
tts: In your watch history you find everything you watched, so you can continue any video from where you stopped.

title: One-button updates
display: When a new version is released, press one button in Settings, and the download and installation start by themselves.
tts: When a new version is released, press one button in Settings, and the download and installation start by themselves.

title: Closing
display: Shasha, in your pocket, calm and safe. Made with love for my family. Ahmad Nayfeh.
